name: filter_lpqi_550_0p5nm
label: LPQI-Pathfinder custom Alluxa 550.0-0.5 flat-top filter (S/N-equivalent rectangle)
sources: F. Prada, email 2026-11-04: 550 nm with a width of 0.50 nm adopted as the single filter of the NOT and TNG cameras
Alluxa 532.1-0.5 OD7 Ultra Narrow Bandpass (part 7083) theory curve, shifted to 550.0 nm: the profile Alluxa quoted for the custom part (P. Nugent, 2026-11-04)
notes: A rectangle with the same pair S/N as the 7083 profile (peak 0.971, FWHM 0.542 nm): width (int T)^2 / int T^2 = 0.649 nm, transmission int T^2 / int T = 0.844, times 0.947 for the relay optics (the 0.9 / 0.95 of the 1 nm filters).
The delivered part is specified at 0.50 nm FWHM (0.40-0.60), peak >= 92 % measured; redo the rectangle from its measured curve.
assumptions: throughput (theory curve of the 532 nm design, not the delivered part)
